content.stem: (audio) When will the company come again?

transcript.speaker: M
transcript.text: I found a notice from the delivery company on my door.

transcript.speaker: W
transcript.text: Oh, did they try to deliver a package while you were out?

transcript.speaker: M
transcript.text: Yes, it says they will come again tomorrow afternoon.

transcript.speaker: W
transcript.text: You should call them if you need to change the time.

content.rationale: The notice says they will come again tomorrow afternoon.
